integrity: Exact analytic proof, boundary uniqueness, functional rank and finite-dimensional norm geometry. Numerical examples only check formulas; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The claim refutes only the necessity of innerness for arbitrary weak-star closed Hardy quotient subspaces, using finite-dimensional quotients. It does not address invariant ideals, infinite-dimensional quotient classification, or the other direction of the conjecture.
title: Strongly extreme Hardy quotients with uniquely minimizing non-inner functions
